page.layout: One column of running text; running head across the top with page number at left; handwritten marginal annotation in brown ink at left margin (not printed, not transcribed); no printed margin notes.

main_text.p: ciderit Iosua. Vniuersus populus qui egressus fuerat ex AEgypto, masculi omnes viri bellatores mortui erant in deserto in itinere posteaquá egresi erant ex AEgypto.
5 Nam circuncisus fuerat totus populus qui egressus est,at totum populum, qui natus fuerat in deserto in itinere, postquam egresi erát ex AEgypto,non circuncriderant.

6 Nam quadraginta annis ambulauerunt filii Israel per desertum, donec consumeretur vniuersa gens virorum bellatorum,qui egresi fuerant ex AEgyptó,qui non audierát vocem Iehouę,quibus iurauerat Iehoua quòd non ostenderet terram de qua iurauerat Iehoua patribus eorum se daturum illis terram fluentem lacte & melle.
7 Filios itaque eorum quos substituit in locum ipsorum circuncidit Iosue, quia incircuncisi erant: neque enim eos circuciderat in itinere.

page.notes: Handwritten brown ink annotation at the left margin is not printed text and was omitted. Underlining in the text appears to be manuscript emphasis and is not transcribed as print. Some letters in the scan are uncertain, notably "circuncriderant" and "circuciderat", which are rendered as read but may be misprints; no [?] markers were added because the readings are fairly clear.
